proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.on_hit_becomes_nonmagical
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's main passive bonus fits the current magic-item surface, but the authored surface cannot express a passive item losing its magic when a hit lands.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical."

notes: Authored as a magic-item variant collection using existing rarity-scaled attack and damage bonus support. The per-hit loss of magic is omitted. Quantity/value text about bundles of ten or twenty pieces is non-core inventory/economy detail and was not modeled.
